meta.title: Add native ARM64 GitHub Actions runner support
meta.body_summary: Replace QEMU emulation with native ARM64 GitHub Actions runners for Docker image builds and CI testing, using ubuntu-22.04-arm after iterative maintainer corrections.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added native ARM64 runner via small CI workflow YAML edits; maintainer Yukaii iteratively corrected runner tag and binary file inclusion via PR comments, no formal review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 24 changed lines across two workflow files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a minimal CI-infra performance PR; it remains open after multiple maintainer-requested corrections (runner tag, binary removal).

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Yukaii requested removal of an accidentally committed bin/act binary and corrected the runner tag from ubuntu-24.04-arm64 → ubuntu-22.04-arm64 → finally ubuntu-22.04-arm, indicating platform-specific naming knowledge.
review_details.performance_claim: Native ARM64 runners improve Docker build and CI speed compared to QEMU emulation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent successfully modified GitHub Actions workflow YAMLs but initially used incorrect runner tags (ubuntu-24.04-arm64, then ubuntu-22.04-arm64), requiring maintainer guidance to use the correct ubuntu-22.04-arm label. This highlights current limitations in knowing platform-specific runner naming conventions.

detection_detail.code_reading: Yukaii reviewed the diff via PR comments, requesting removal of bin/act and specifying the correct ubuntu-22.04-arm runner tag.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or CI execution logs comparing native vs QEMU build times; performance claims are purely narrative.

core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/push-image.yml and build.yml, replaced ubuntu-latest with native ubuntu-22.04-arm runner, removed QEMU setup step, and added ARM64 matrix testing. Accidentally committed then removed bin/act binary.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: bin/act was added in a validation commit and then removed per maintainer request.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added ARM64 runner with ubuntu-24.04-arm64 and removed QEMU in push-image.yml, added ARM64 to build.yml.
Subsequent commits: removed bin/act binary, changed runner to ubuntu-22.04-arm64, then to ubuntu-22.04-arm as instructed.

review_signals.summary: Requested removal of the accidentally committed bin/act binary file.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed the binary in commit 6968070.

review_signals.summary: Instructed to use ubuntu-22.04-arm instead of 24.04.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot changed to ubuntu-22.04-arm64 then corrected to ubuntu-22.04-arm.

review_signals.summary: Reacted with laughter to GitHub community discussion about ARM runner naming.

review_signals.action_taken: Copilot updated both workflows to use ubuntu-22.04-arm.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial ARM64 runner change.
Maintainer requested binary removal; Copilot complied.
Maintainer requested runner version switch; Copilot iteratively corrected the tag.
Maintainer reacted to naming issue; later provided the exact tag, PR still open.
